content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

There are parliamentary elections soon and traditionally the governing party is generous with popular promises in the run-up to federal elections. Nevertheless the head of government, Merkel, had better restrain herself in announcing handouts this year. Voters have become more sceptical. Too many promises have not been kept.
What argument components exists in sentence "There are parliamentary elections soon and traditionally the governing party is generous with popular promises in the run-up to federal elections" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<opp>There are parliamentary elections soon</opp> <opp>and traditionally the governing party is generous with popular promises in the run-up to federal elections</opp>
